product_overview: CompraYa is a multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace for shoppers, vendors, and administrators in Santa Cruz, Bolivia. Users can browse products, manage a cart, place delivery orders, track couriers in real time, and manage vendor inventory.
core_goals: Browse and discover products through catalog search and category filtering
View detailed product information and select product variants
Add products to a shopping cart and adjust quantities
Complete checkout with delivery information and payment method selection
Track delivery progress and courier location after placing an order
Manage vendor inventory and create new products
Review admin store and business overview metrics

features.name: Catalog Search and Filtering
features.description: Users can browse the home catalog, narrow products by category, and search instantly across the product list.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a category pill -> Observe the product grid filter to matching items -> Type a search term -> Observe the catalog update in real time -> Clear the search to restore the full catalog

features.name: Product Details and Variant Selection
features.description: Users can open a product page to review images, pricing, and available variants before adding the item to the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/[id] -> Review the product gallery and details -> Select a variant option -> Observe the selection state update -> Add the item to the cart -> See the cart reflect the selected product

features.name: Shopping Cart and Quantity Management
features.description: Users can manage items already in the cart by changing quantities, removing items, and continuing to checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> Increase an item quantity -> Observe the subtotal update -> Decrease an item quantity -> Observe the subtotal update again -> Remove an item from the cart -> See the item disappear from the list -> Continue to checkout

features.name: Order Checkout
features.description: Users can submit delivery information, choose a payment method, and confirm an order from the checkout page.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Fill in customer name, phone, and delivery address -> Select a payment method -> Confirm the order -> See the order created and proceed to tracking
Navigate to /checkout -> Leave required delivery fields empty -> Submit the form -> See validation messages for the missing fields

features.name: OpenDSP Live Delivery Tracking
features.description: Users can view live delivery progress, courier movement, and driver contact details for an active order.
user_flows: Navigate to /order/track/[id] -> View the step-by-step delivery progress -> Observe the courier marker moving on the map -> Review the driver contact card -> Use the phone link to contact the courier

features.name: Vendor Inventory Management and Product Creation
features.description: Vendors can search their inventory, open the add-product flow, validate required fields, and save a new product.
user_flows: Navigate to /vendor/inventory -> Search the inventory table -> Observe the list filter to matching products -> Open the add-product modal -> Submit the form with missing fields -> See required-field validation messages -> Fill in the product title, price, and stock -> Save the product -> See the new item appear in inventory

features.name: Admin Overview
features.description: Administrators can open the admin area to review business summary information and store management data.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Review the dashboard overview and GMV metrics -> Inspect store management information

routes.description: Home catalog, category pills, product grid, real-time search
Shopping cart drawer and page with quantity adjustment
Checkout with QR Simple / Card payment selection and delivery info
Product details with image gallery and variant selection
Live satellite GPS tracking of courier and delivery progress
Vendor inventory table, stock management, and add product modal
Admin overview, GMV metrics, and store management

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Login with test credentials, email/phone, or social login in 1-click
user_interactions: Click Iniciar Sesion button in header
Enter email test.buyer@compraya.bo or phone 77098765
Click Submit or select Google / TikTok login
View authenticated profile in header
Click Cerrar Sesion to logout

Type search query in search input
Click Add to Cart button on product card

Click - button to decrement quantity
Click remove item button
Click Continuar al Checkout button

View courier marker moving on map
